verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes a documented XML API (api.namecheap.com/xml.response, sandbox) and has an official Terraform provider that manages DNS records as individual resources (create/update/delete), plus a Go SDK for domain operations, indicating programmatic DNS management is possible. However, the pack shows only API error snippets rather than actual endpoint documentation for record CRUD (e.g., setHosts), no explicit mention of ACME/DNS-01 challenge support, and the Go SDK README lists domain lifecycle methods but not DNS record CRUD calls directly. missing for 10: direct API doc excerpts for DNS record create/update/delete endpoints, explicit ACME challenge automation example, independent hands-on confirmation of record CRUD via API.
